@ET  AnewListening and Reading test is

written for each test each month with a
different topic. This means each month
the challenge of the test is slightly more
or slightly less than any other month.
This is reflected in the grade boundaries
which are set for each test. This means
there isn't a pass score we can tell you to
aim for because the pass score for one
test will be different for another.

The advice we give to candidates is to
aim for two thirds of the questions in the
test you are taking to be correct. On test
day, you may need a few more or a few
less to achieve a B based on the
challenge of the paper that month but it
gives you something to aim for. During
practice, we recommend aiming for a
score in the low 30s to be confident of a
B on test day.

If you are consistently achieving 30-32
in practice, you can feel confident of
achieving a B whatever the pass score. It
is better to aim higher than aim for the
absolute minimum.
